title: napi: fix build error in cargo-auditable
author: JohnRTitor
summary: Changes napi/Cargo.toml `bundler = ["dep:crossbeam-channel", "dep:rayon"]` to use `"rayon"` so `cargo auditable` (used by default in Nixpkgs) can build. The maintainer believes the current manifest is correct and that this is a cargo-auditable bug; the change is harmless (it just also exposes an implicit `rayon` feature).
evidence: devongovett 2024-05-25: "Mainly that I don't understand the problem. AFAICT it is correct ... I don't know what `cargo-auditable` is but perhaps that has a bug?" Author replied explaining cargo-auditable; no follow-up. Nixpkgs master still carries this exact patch for lightningcss 1.33.0 (`./0001-napi-fix-build-error-in-cargo-auditable.patch`, comment "FIXME: remove when merged upstream"). cargo-auditable changelog through 0.7.7 (2026-10-02) shows no fix for this. Master napi/Cargo.toml line 13 unchanged.
decision: Accept a one-line Cargo.toml workaround for a cargo-auditable bug that Nixpkgs has been patching downstream since 2024, or close it and point them to report it to cargo-auditable?
